proof_scope: Tau Python workspace kernel receipt and lifecycle coverage

claims.proves: the declared Tau Python workspace positive and adversarial kernel receipt checks pass across repeated trials using the real project test runner and optional Jupyter kernel profile
claims.does_not_prove: full Tau issue #323 production rollout, kernel sandboxing, host-call bridge behavior, provider/model quality, or every operating-system process-loss mode

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau Python workspace kernel runs the worker and backend lifecycle through the real optional Jupyter profile while enforcing capability, binding, import failure, interrupt, and PID reuse boundaries.

reasons: command does not reach a substantive production entrypoint
